title: aspidium krameri
intro: Aspidium krameri, commonly known as the Krameri fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Aspidium krameri are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
